# DappGo News

> Read-only market news reader backed by DappGo's published dashboard data.

- [Taiwan edition](https://news.dappgo.com/tw/)
- [United States edition](https://news.dappgo.com/us/)

The editions include static published headlines and links to stock pages at
`/us/<SYMBOL>/` and `/tw/<CODE>/`. A stock page exists when its published payload
contains at least three distinct eligible stories. Other stocks use the edition's
`?stock=` view. The sitemap lists the currently generated stock pages. Snapshots
are rebuilt on the weekday homepage-pulse schedule; they are not live data.

The site reads the formal DappGo market pointer and its immutable payload
through a same-origin read-only Pages Function. It does not trigger jobs or
accept write operations. Use each article's source link for the original
publication; summaries may be absent when the source provides no independent
description.
